Job Title: Specialist, Change Control & Data Retrieval/Collection Job Description This hybrid role supports the Instruments Product Environmental Compliance (PEC) portfolio by leading structured data retrieval, collection, and change control activities. The Specialist, Change Control & Data Retrieval/Collection builds strong cross-functional relationships, gathers and validates complex data from internal systems and external suppliers, and ensures that product information is accurate, traceable, and ready for regulatory submissions and internal reporting. The position focuses on enabling compliance with key PEC regulations such as REACH, RoHS, PFAS, and PPWR while continuously improving data collection processes and tools. Responsibilities Lead data retrieval and collection efforts across internal systems such as PLM, ERP, and Quality Management Systems, as well as from external suppliers, to support Product Environmental Compliance (PEC) regulatory requirements including REACH, RoHS, PFAS, and PPWR. Compile, cleanse, and validate complex datasets to ensure accuracy, traceability, and readiness for regulatory submissions and internal reporting. Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, and external suppliers to obtain material, component, and product-level compliance data. Create and manage Enterprise Change Notices (ECNs) within the Quality Management System to implement updates tied to PEC findings, ensuring documentation and data inputs are compliant and audit-ready. Translate regulatory requirements into clear data needs by identifying required attributes, documentation, and evidence to support compliance initiatives. Support supplier engagement and outreach by requesting, tracking, and following up on material declarations, certifications, and compliance documentation. Perform data analysis and gap assessments to identify missing, inconsistent, or incomplete information and drive resolution with stakeholders. Maintain and update project tracking tools and dashboards to provide visibility into data collection progress, risks, and completion status across PEC programs. Contribute to process improvements by standardizing data collection methods, templates, and workflows to enhance efficiency, consistency, and scalability of PEC efforts. Act as Change Owner when needed, coordinating implementation plans and ensuring execution aligns with regulatory timelines and project milestones. Build and maintain strong cross-functional and global relationships to gather, validate, and align data across teams, suppliers, and systems. Proactively identify gaps in data availability, quality, and processes, and recommend enhancements to improve data integrity and reporting. Implement and manage document control processes for accuracy and accessibility of compliance documents. Handle routine inquiries, review documents, and ensure timely submission. Promote good communication and coordination with other departments. Guide and support project management team members as needed. This role focuses on designing and maintaining robust data quality rules for utility billing and energy performance data, verifying savings for performance contracts, and delivering actionable insights to Energy Managers. You will work across SQL, data processing tools, and analytics platforms to ensure that utility data is accurate, savings are correctly calculated, and clients receive clear, reliable reporting that supports energy and cost reduction goals. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain a comprehensive library of rules that detect utility data faults, including missing or late bills, double-counted or redelivered bills, new or replaced meters not reflected in building totals, rate and demand anomalies, and baseline drift. Run automated screenings across every client portfolio on a regular schedule and route flagged issues into a prioritized Jira backlog, directing routine data fixes to the Utility Coordinator and savings-related questions to Energy Managers. Test each data quality rule against known cases, monitor false alarms and missed issues, and continuously tune or retire rules that do not provide sufficient value. Develop solutions in SQL and modern data processing tools, using AI technologies where they accelerate development or review, and produce clear, maintainable code and documentation that the broader team can run and support. Automate manual components of savings verification, cost analysis, and annual reporting to increase efficiency and consistency. Investigate savings that do not reconcile across the data warehouse, the energy management platform, and cost analysis workbooks, tracing each discrepancy to a root cause and quantifying its financial impact. Provide each Energy Manager with a regular portfolio watchlist that highlights what has changed, what is at risk, and which items should be discussed with the client. Lead data review activities before dashboards and annual reports are delivered to clients, including documenting non-routine events such as vacancies, fuel conversions, and building changes. Write clear, actionable findings for Energy Managers that describe the issue, its effect on savings, the recommended fix and the order in which to apply it, and the validation steps that confirm it worked. Own annual savings verification for performance contracts against weather-adjusted baselines, project models, and guaranteed savings, in alignment with IPMVP practices. Ensure building totals and baselines remain accurate when meters are added or replaced, and verify the integrity of the data after changes. Review how savings are priced against utility tariffs, including demand ratchets and customer charges, to confirm that savings calculations and pricing are correct. Job Title: GIS Analyst Job Description The GIS Analyst will support Operation Services, an internal department that aids construction projects. The role involves completing engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS for various main and service works, collecting construction activity 'as-built' data with mobile CPS devices in the field, creating permanent asset records, and editing map features and correlating attribute data in GIS. The analyst will also perform final quality checks on GIS versioned data before posting, represent Engineering at project meetings, and conduct field visits to job sites to determine requirements for service and main work. Responsibilities Complete engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS for all types of main and service work. Collect construction activity 'as-built' using mobile CPS devices in the field for creating permanent asset records. Edit map features and correlating attribute data in the GIS. Perform final quality checks on GIS versioned data before it is posted to the GIS. Represent Engineering at internal and external project meetings as required. Skill in editing map features and correlating attribute data in GIS. Job Title: Lab Analyst Job Description The Lab Analyst performs routine environmental sample testing using GC and GC-MS instrumentation in a dedicated analytical laboratory. Strong attention to detail in both analytical work and documentation. Ability to accurately record sample information, testing steps, and results. Capability to work a consistent TuesdaySaturday schedule on first shift. Additional Skills & Qualifications EPA Method 8260 experience is highly preferred. Experience with VOC (volatile organic compound) analysis is a plus. Previous environmental laboratory experience is preferred. Interest in developing deeper technical experience with GC and GC-MS instrumentation. Motivation to build a career in environmental analytical testing within an established laboratory environment. The position is fully hands-on, working directly with environmental samples and analytical instrumentation such as GC and GC-MS systems. Date Posted: 11/09/2026 Hiring Organization: Rose International Position Number: 510531 Industry: IT Company/Software Job Title: Warehouse Operations & Logistics Analyst (SAP / Reverse Logistics) Job Location: Irving, TX, USA, 75063 Work Model: Onsite Shift: 8 AM to 5 PM Central Employment Type: Temporary FT/PT: Full-Time Estimated Duration (In months): 12 Min Hourly Rate($): 45.00 Max Hourly Rate($): 55.00 Must Have Skills/Attributes: ERP, Logistics, MS Excel, SAP, Warehouse Experience Desired: Warehouse / distribution operations (3-5 yrs), SAP inventory transactions and reporting (3-5 yrs), Excel and data reconciliation (3-5 yrs), 3PL coordination (3-5 yrs) **C2C is not available** Job Description *** This role is supporting NVIDIA *** Required Skills and Experience: â¢ 3â5 years of experience in warehouse operations, service logistics, distribution center, or supply chain support â¢ Hands-on experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and ERP tools â SAP experience strongly preferred (MMBE, VL03N, SE16, LX02, IQ09, MB1A) â¢ Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple open tasks and priorities simultaneously â¢ Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; comfortable working with operational data sets â¢ Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills â¢ Ability to work on-site and engage directly with warehouse floor teams daily Preferred Skills and Experience: â¢ Background in reverse logistics, RMA receiving, or non-conformance handling â¢ Experience supporting operations at a 3PL or contract warehouse for a large OEM or tech company â¢ Familiarity with WHI (Warehouse Interface) or similar warehouse management tools â¢ Experience with data analytics or operational reporting in a supply chain environment Seeking a Service Logistics Analyst to provide on-site operational support at our 3PL warehouse in Irving, TX. This role works directly under the Program Manager of Execution and is responsible for supporting day-to-day warehouse operations, driving floor-level task execution, and assisting with data analysis and reporting to support operational decision-making. The ideal candidate is hands-on and organized â equally comfortable on the warehouse floor engaging with supervisors on same-day priorities as they are pulling SAP data or tracking open escalations in a spreadsheet. This person helps ensure that direction from program leadership translates into real execution on the ground. Responsibilities: Warehouse Floor Support & Execution â¢ Provide on-site daily support at the 3PL warehouse, serving as an operational extension of the Program Manager â¢ Follow up with warehouse supervisors and team leads to drive completion of open action
